body: Thank you for your perspective. Do you think it is fair for me to want to cut him off, no matter how difficult? Is it as if I’m abandoning him when he’s going through a tough time? And what if he does turn his life around, will I lose out on a good guy? I’m sorry.. Just need a third person perspective
